label: Connection criticality
subgoals: Divide the connection's slack by the critical-path delay
Subtract from 1 to get the criticality
Raise it to the criticality exponent theta

label: Timing cost
subgoals: Look up each connection's placement-based delay
Weight each delay by its criticality to the theta

label: Blending timing and wirelength
subgoals: Normalize each cost change by its previous total
Weight timing by lambda and wirelength by 1 minus lambda
Sum to get the move's delta C
